decision.explanation: The question asks which league Antwan Peek plays in. Two distinct pieces of evidence are provided: (1) D1S3 explicitly states that Antwan Peek was an active participant in the NCAA Division I men's basketball league during his college career. (2) D2S2 confirms that as of the time of the second document, Antwan Peek is playing in Japan's Pacific League as a professional baseball player. These are separate contexts—college basketball and professional baseball—and both are directly stated in the sources. There is no contradiction between these claims because they refer to different periods and sports. Both answers are valid and complementary.
